newsitem.title: FRANCE: French July-Dec grain use in feed seen up 11.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: French July-Dec grain use in feed seen up 11.8 pct.

text.p: Use of French grain in animal feed jumped 11.8 percent to 4.583 million tonnes in the first six months of the 1996/97 campaign (July/June) compared with the same period for 1995/96, data prepared ahead of next Wednesday's monthly meeting of France's grain office ONIC showed.
Grain use in feed between July 1 and December 31, 1996 breaks down as follows (in '000 tonnes)-
Soft wheat barley maize durum grain total
ONIC predicted in December that some 9.4 million tonnes of grain would be fed to animals in the whole 1996/97 season, an increase of 12.3 percent over the previous season.
Wheat usage was put at six million tonnes, barley usage at 1.1 million and maize usage at 2.3 million tonnes.
The data remain subject to approval by ONIC members before publicaton on February 12.
